summary: Write This Down is an American Christian rock band from Minneapolis, Minnesota, formed in 2005. The note lists the band's four members and says its music received regular rotation on Internet-based radio stations RadioU and ChristianRock.Net. It also notes that the album "Write This Down" peaked at No. 45 on Billboard's Christian Albums chart on May 10, 2010.
one_line: Write This Down is a Minneapolis-based American Christian rock band formed in 2005, known for its 2010 Billboard Christian Albums chart entry.
key_facts: Write This Down is an American Christian rock band from Minneapolis, Minnesota.
Write This Down was formed in 2005.
The band consists of vocalists and guitarists Nate Rockwell and Mike Kuwica.
Nick Lombardo is the bassist of Write This Down.
Chad Nichols is the drummer of Write This Down.
The music of Write This Down has been featured on Internet-based radio stations.
Write This Down received regular rotation on RadioU.
Write This Down received regular rotation on ChristianRock.Net.
On May 10, 2010, the album "Write This Down" peaked at No. 45 on Billboard's Christian Albums chart.
